work_order.approach: Fix each finding at its root with the smallest possible diff. (1) kpiStrip in src/web/pages.js reads the tenant row already (it formats money with tenant.currency) but calls computeFunnel(rows) without the second argument, while GET /v1/metrics passes the tenant currency — pass tenant.currency ?? 'INR' so both surfaces share the identical tenant-wide rule. (2) latestTimestamp on the raw-event repository has zero callers (dataThrough over listByTypes serves staleness everywhere) — delete the method and its now-unused latestForTenant prepared statement. (3) journeyRows in test/domain/measurement.test.js destructures tenantId but never stamps it on rows, and the cross-tenant test additionally varies event_ids via suffix so it passes for the wrong reason — stamp tenant_id on every row and use identical event_ids across the two tenants so the test proves tenant-keyed dedup.
work_order.confidence_rationale: All three findings were verified line-by-line against current main: the unguarded computeFunnel call, the caller-free method, and the tenantId parameter that is destructured and dropped. Each fix is a one-to-three-line change following an existing in-repo pattern (routes.js already passes the currency; dataThrough already replaces the method).
evidence: src/web/pages.js:341 computeFunnel(rows) with no currency while src/api/routes.js:142 passes tenantCurrency from the tenant row
src/web/pages.js:352 already reads tenant.currency for formatting, so the tenant row (with currency) is available at the call site
repo-wide grep for latestTimestamp returns only its definition at src/data/repositories.js:101 plus the latestForTenant statement at :63; dataThrough is what pages.js and routes.js actually call

test/domain/measurement.test.js:21 journeyRows destructures tenantId but returned rows carry no tenant_id field; the cross-tenant test at :80-82 additionally uses suffix '_x' so event_ids differ and volume 6 follows with or without tenant isolation
src/domain/measurement.js:183 dedup key is tenant_id:event_id, confirming what the fixed test must exercise

work_order.root_cause: (1) kpiStrip passed raw rows to computeFunnel without the tenantCurrency argument that GET /v1/metrics passes, so the dashboard summed foreign-currency legacy spend the API excludes. (2) latestTimestamp is leftover from before dataThrough-over-listByTypes became the staleness mechanism; nothing calls it. (3) The journeyRows helper accepts tenantId but never writes it onto rows, and the cross-tenant test varies event_ids with suffix '_x', so volume 6 follows from distinct ids alone and tenant-keyed dedup is never exercised.

work_order.understanding: Issue #31 carries three non-blocking review findings from #29, each explicitly requiring re-verification before planning since that PR kept moving. I verified all three against current main and all three still reproduce: (1) the dashboard KPI strip (src/web/pages.js:341) calls computeFunnel(rows) without the tenant currency while GET /v1/metrics (src/api/routes.js:142) passes it, so pre-fix mixed-currency legacy rows corrupt dashboard CPL while the API excludes them; (2) latestTimestamp in src/data/repositories.js:101 has zero callers anywhere in the repo (staleness goes through dataThrough); (3) journeyRows in test/domain/measurement.test.js:21 accepts tenantId but never stamps tenant_id on rows, and the cross-tenant test additionally gives the second tenant different event_ids (suffix _x), so its volume-6 assertion passes with or without tenant-keyed dedup.
